definition: At least one first-line regimen record lacks an end date
Identical type/agent/start/end records within the first-line regimen
Hormonal, targeted, immunotherapy or unspecified pharmaceutical record in the regimen
Bevacizumab recorded within the first-line regimen window
The first-line systemic end is set only by a bevacizumab record
Radiotherapy ends after the systemic regimen and sets the therapy end
Systemic record starting >42 days after the first start, within the start window
Such a later systemic record starts before the computed first-line end (possible switch)
First-line start recorded before the diagnosis date
Therapy end missing or outside 60-365 days
